title: Start menu and Notepad
summary: Open a program and type a note.

steps.say: Click the Start button at the bottom of the screen.
steps.detail: It is the blue Windows logo.
steps.hint: Look in the middle of the bar along the bottom.

steps.detail: Notepad is a simple place to type notes.

steps.text: Hello, this is my first note.
steps.say: Click in the white area and type: Hello, this is my first note.
steps.detail: Type it just like on a typewriter.

steps.say: Click the X to close Notepad.
steps.detail: Windows will ask about saving. That is a good thing.
In the next lesson you will learn how to save.
